---
title: "prac2_exercises"
---

Using the pipe operator
```{r}
input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)
input_vec <- input_vec|>
  mean()|>
  abs()|>
  round()
print(input_vec)
```

Using the comparison operator
```{r}
y <- 12
print(y == 7)
print(y < 15)
print(y > 20)
print(y <= 12)
```

Joining data frames with non-unique values
```{r}
birds <- tibble(
  Bird = c("Robin", "Robin", "Blackbird"),
  Mass = c(18, 19, 100)
)

observations <- tibble(
  Bird = c("Robin", "Robin", "Robin", "Blackbird"),
  Count = c(4, 7, 2, 5)
)

inner_join(birds, observations, by = "Bird")
```
